name: EPIC 220149512
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.2 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220149512 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.247751 (16th-84th percentiles 8.976041-9.509151), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220149512 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1817.734375 (16th-84th percentiles 1786.074219-1850.566406), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,818 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.86 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,148 K at its surface.
